title: Numerical Methods in Engineering
description:
Recommended: Senior standing.
Restriction: Permission of ENGR-Mechanical Engineering department.
Jointly offered with: ENME745.
Credit only granted for: ENME745, ENME808B, ENME417 or ENME489J.
Formerly: ENME489J. Covers the fundamental aspects of how to apply analytical mathematical concepts to discrete data. The course is aimed at graduate students and senior undergraduate students in any area of engineering, and treats the material in a general manner that is not specific to any application or field of specialization.
